Want to be an entrepreneur? You don’t have to quit your day job to do so. Entrepreneur and CEO of @appsumo @noahkagan wants everyone to feel empowered to start a business – even if all you have is 30 minutes a week. Noah joined Masters of Scale host @jeffberman to share lessons from his scale journey and from the early flameouts at high-profile start-ups – like being employee number 30 at @facebook and an early staffer at @mint – that fueled a desire to prove himself. 🎧 Listen at the link in our bio.

In business and in life you're going to have to ask for things that might make you uncomfortable in order to grow.

Whether you actually ask for those things or not is going to depend on how strong your "fear muscle" is.

The coffee challenge is one of the best exercises you can do to work on that fear muscle.

How does it work?

Next time you're ordering coffee ask for 10% off at the counter. That's it. *If you don't drink coffee, just substitute coffee with anything else you fancy.

Now, who accepts the coffee challenge?

If you do it this weekend, record yourself and DM the footage to me. I may or may not shout you out in my next YouTube video ;)

I just released a conversation I had with my good friend @realtuckermax on YouTube and on the Podcast this morning.

Tucker is a bestselling author who’s sold over 3 million copies of his books worldwide.

He’s also the founder of the book publishing company @scribemediaco whose mission it is to help everyone on earth write and publish their own book.

Some of you might know that I’ve been thinking of writing my own book. So on this call I basically ask Tucker all of the questions I’ve been struggling with myself.

A couple things we talk about:

1) The one big question you should ask yourself before you ever start writing a book.

2) The good and bad motivations for writing a book (hint: don't do it for the money)

3) Tucker and I get vulnerable about how we’re not living up to our full potential and what we’re doing about it.

If writing a book is something you see yourself doing at some point down the road, you’ll love this episode. (Link to my YouTube channel in my bio)

I just released an interview with my good friend @tombilyeu. He's the co-founder of the billion dollar protein bar company @questnutrition and of @impacttheory.

The interview is available on Apple Podcast, Spotify and on my YouTube channel (link in my bio)

If you listened to the interview already, I would love to hear what you thought!

I've started a lot of companies over the last 20 years. 24 to be precise.

So I thought I'd put together a video to walk you through every business I've ever started.

These are just the highlights. If you want the details for each business head over to bit.ly/20years24biz

A few years ago I asked our @appsumo customers to challenge me to start a business in under 24 hours. This is what happened.

To watch the last 7 minutes of the video go to bit.ly/sumojerky

You should ALWAYS ask for a discount.

Whether you're buying a coffee, renting an airbnb, or asking your landlord for a discount on rent during COVID-19, you should always ask.

Sometimes you'll get the discount, but a lot of times you won't.

Getting the discount is nice, but honestly the real gold lies behind outcome #2:

When you get REJECTED and realize that everything’s OK. That's what the coffee challenge is all about.

It's about building up your fear muscle.

If you take on the coffee challenge enough times, you'll start building the habit of facing your fears on a daily basis. Once you build that habit, you become unstoppable.

So who's up for the challenge?

If you take the challenge this week, have someone record you and tag me in your IG Stories, I will repost all of you.

Let's get it!
